stem: George Mason refused to sign the Constitution and opposed its ratification because he believed that it —

options.label: A
options.text: did not adequately protect individuals from potential government abuse

options.label: B
options.text: did not give the executive branch enough power to oversee the military

options.label: C
options.text: prevented the legislative branch from effectively governing the states

options.label: D
options.text: prevented the judicial branch from using judicial review to overturn acts of the legislature

visual_elements: 43 George Mason refused to sign the Constitution and opposed its ratification because he believed that it —
A did not adequately protect individuals from potential government abuse
B did not give the executive branch enough power to oversee the military
C prevented the legislative branch from effectively governing the states
D prevented the judicial branch from using judicial review to overturn acts of the legislature
